title: Scene Breakpoints Configuration Schema
description: Configuration schema for VS Code Scene Breakpoints (.vscode/debug-scenes.json)

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URI for auto-completion and validation

oneOf.description: List of active debug scene names to activate and layer
Single active debug scene name (fallback compatibility)

activeScenes.description: Currently activated debug scene(s). Modifying this triggers declarative scene switching.

bindings.description: Map debug launch configuration names (from launch.json) to scene names

oneOf.description: Single debug scene name to activate upon launch
Composite debug scene names to layer upon launch

scenes.description: Debug scene dictionary mapping scene names to breakpoint lists

type.description: Type of the breakpoint: line, condition, hit, logpoint, or function

file.description: Relative POSIX file path from workspace root (e.g. src/index.ts)

line.description: 1-based line number in the source file

desc.description: Human-readable description or note for this breakpoint

enabled.description: Whether this breakpoint is enabled or disabled

condition.description: Boolean expression that must evaluate to true for execution to pause

logMessage.description: Log message to print in the Debug Console (supports {variable} interpolation)

functionName.description: Name of the function/method to intercept across files

snippet.description: Lexical fingerprint of the target line used by the self-healing engine

contextBefore.description: Lexical fingerprint of the preceding line used by the self-healing engine

contextAfter.description: Lexical fingerprint of the succeeding line used by the self-healing engine
